exact_target: For every infinite finitely generated group Gamma and every prescribed finite symmetric generating set S excluding identity, let G be its simple undirected Cayley graph. Under independent Bernoulli bond percolation, pc(G)<pu(G) if and only if Gamma is nonamenable. pc is the infimum of p for which the root has positive probability of an infinite cluster; pu is the infimum of p for which there is almost surely exactly one infinite cluster.
